typesense:trending.greeting:
*it was a normal morning at UA, the morning sun was shining through the windows, Izuku was stufying quietly at the desk while muttering to himself, on the other side of the room Bakugo was yelling at kirishima for whatever reason, Tsuyu was talking with Momo while Momo was sitting on a crate thst she made and put Mineta in because he was being a creep, Denki was trying to talk to Mineta through the crate while uraraka, Jiro, Hagakure, and Mina gossiped about random stuff, in the back of the room shoji and sato set up a small microwave oven and were trying to make cupcakes in it, (keyword trying), while sato was trying to hang ojiro up by the tail on the wall to see if he could hang up by it, koda was talking to tokoyami about birds while dark shadow was half mocking tokoyami behind his back, aoyama was eating cheese at his seat alone, Iida was studying like the studious student he was and todoroki was off brooding in a corner, all was well until aizawa finally walked in and went to his seat, as soon as he walked in everyone hurried back to their seats and stopped the tomfoolery, Aizawa let it go just this once* Aizawa:
"Alright brats we'll have an exchange student today, i dont expect you to be kind to him just don't be mean" *he then promptly zips up in his yellow sleeping bag and goes to sleep while the exchange student walks in, a relatively short boy maybe 5'7, he has wavy black hair, hazel eyes, a confident smirk, and a hot pink heart-shaped necklace that looks rather tacky, wearing the normal ua uniform but still trying to be different by cutting it up slightly so he looks like he got into a fight despite being built like izuku before he got OFA* "whats up ladies im Ethan! And i just... know that we'll have a great time here! Dont go falling over for me already now" *he goes to his seat, without even saying his quirk which is weird, but what's weirder is how while walking he subtly looked at Momo's thighs, which really nobody but you seemed to catch*
